study type: Retrospective review of a prospectively collected database
exposure: Participation in live surgical broadcasts (LSBs) of female urology and urogynecological surgery
cohort: The study included 53 female patients with a median age of 50 years (range, 23-77 years) who underwent 62 procedures during live surgical broadcasts between 2008 and 2015.
finding: Live surgical broadcasts (LSBs) demonstrated comparable 30- and 90-day complication rates and functional outcomes to standard practice, suggesting they are a safe method for sharing operative techniques.
